summary: Russia launched a massive overnight aerial assault using 74 missiles and 284 UAVs against Ukraine, while an X-101 cruise missile crossed into Polish territory. Ukraine struck aviation infrastructure in occupied Evpatoria and a Lukoil refinery in Volgograd. Explosions occurred at a military site in Khmelnitskyi with secondary detonation.
key_points: Russia launched a massive overnight aerial assault using 74 missiles and 284 UAVs against Ukraine, while an X-101 cruise missile also crossed into Polish territory, prompting Warsaw to summon the Russian ambassador. (Source: @UkraineNow/83042, @ukr_leaks_eng/32062)

Poland officially confirmed that a Russian X-101 cruise missile struck its territory yesterday, with Deputy Defense Minister Cezary Tomczyk noting the missile is capable of carrying a nuclear warhead. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32062)

Ukraine's defense forces struck the Evpatoria aviation factory, two aircraft hangars, a production workshop, and Lukoil refinery infrastructure in occupied Crimea, while also hitting a Lukoil refinery in Volgograd, Russia. (Source: @UkraineNow/83049)

Russia destroyed a US-owned Terminal Autonomy drone manufacturing facility in Kyiv, which may represent the first strike on an American company's property during the ongoing conflict, according to The Guardian. (Source: @UkraineNow/83046)

A powerful explosion with secondary detonation occurred at a military training ground in Khmelnitskyi on 31 July 2026, with casualties and the exact cause still under investigation by security services. (Source: @eRadarrua/103445, @ukr_leaks_eng/32072)

At least eight people were injured when Ukrainian forces attacked a Krasnodar-Donetsk bus near the settlement of Kuteynikovo in eastern DNR using a foreign-made unmanned aerial vehicle, regional authorities reported. (Source: @tass_agency/388062)

Poland officially proposed a weapons swap with Ukraine involving the transfer of MiG-29 fighter jets in exchange for Ukrainian attack drones, as confirmed by Polish Deputy Defense Minister Paulina Sobkowiak-Czarnecka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32075)

sections.executive_summary: Russia launched a massive overnight aerial assault using 74 missiles and 284 UAVs against Ukraine, while an X-101 cruise missile crossed into Polish territory. Ukraine struck aviation infrastructure in occupied Evpatoria and a Lukoil refinery in Volgograd. Explosions occurred at a military site in Khmelnitskyi with secondary detonation, and at least eight people were injured in a VSU attack on a bus in eastern DNR.

points: Ukraine's defense forces struck the Evpatoria aviation factory in occupied Crimea, destroying two aircraft hangars used for storing aviation equipment and a production workshop at the facility, while also hitting port infrastructure in Taman. (Source: @UkraineNow/83049)

A powerful explosion with secondary detonation occurred at a military training ground in Khmelnitskyi on 31 July 2026, with the cause and casualties still being established by security services at the scene. (Source: @eRadarrua/103445)

Russia destroyed a US-owned Terminal Autonomy drone manufacturing facility in Kyiv, which produces strike drones capable of completing attacks even under Russian electronic warfare conditions, according to The Guardian. (Source: @UkraineNow/83046)

Zelensky stated that Ukraine has lost 50,000 service members over four and a half years of war, revising the earlier figure of 55,000 announced on 4 February of this year. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32068)

93 percent of verified shelters in Ukraine have structural problems, according to Reuters, raising concerns about civilian protection during ongoing Russian aerial attacks across the country. (Source: @UkraineNow/83042)

Ukraine received €2.5 billion from the EU within a €90 billion credit line to purchase 16 Swedish Gripen fighter jets, with the total deal valued at €3.47 billion and Sweden providing older models free this year. (Source: @UkraineNow/83030)

Ukraine officially proposed a weapons swap with Poland involving the transfer of MiG-29 fighter jets in exchange for Ukrainian drones, as confirmed by Polish Deputy Defense Minister Paulina Sobkowiak-Czarnecka. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32075)

A Wildberries warehouse fire broke out in Volgograd, Russia, alongside a fire at a fuel-energy complex, likely the Lukoil-Volgogradneftepererabotka refinery, with a separate Wildberries warehouse also attacked in Zelenodolsk. (Source: @UkraineNow/83057)

Russian forces destroyed more than 200 gas stations across Ukraine, with at least 80 of them located in the Kharkiv region, according to Kharkiv Regional Council deputy Aleksandr Skoryk. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32066)
Russian forces struck a sorting complex of Nova Poshta in the Podgornoye area of Dnipropetrovsk Oblast, according to TASS reports of overnight Russian aerial operations. (Source: @tass_agency/388077)
Russia conducted overnight strikes using 74 missiles and 284 UAVs against Ukraine, representing a significant escalation in the scale of aerial bombardment. (Source: @UkraineNow/83042)

An X-101 cruise missile fired by Russia crossed into Polish territory, with Poland's Deputy Defense Minister confirming the incident and noting the missile's capability to carry a nuclear warhead. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32062)

At least eight people were injured when VSU attacked a Krasnodar-Donetsk bus near the settlement of Kuteynikovo in eastern DNR using a foreign-made unmanned aerial vehicle, reported the head of Amvrosiievsky district. (Source: @tass_agency/388062)

Active enemy tactical aviation was detected on the northeastern front, with a threat of aviation weapons being used against frontline oblasts, according to a warning issued by kpszsu channel. (Source: @kpszsu/70912)
A fast-moving target was detected on the Kharkiv region toward Veliky Burluk from the north, indicating continued Russian ground activity in the northeastern sector. (Source: @kpszsu/70902)
Reactive UAVs were observed in the Chernihiv region toward Pryluky, Nizhyn, and Lynovytsia, suggesting continued Ukrainian drone operations in the northern-eastern area. (Source: @kpszsu/70892)
Reactive UAVs were observed in the Chernihiv region toward Pryluky, Nizhyn, and Lynovytsia, indicating ongoing Ukrainian drone activity in the northern front sector. (Source: @kpszsu/70892)
A UAV was detected in the Chernihiv region moving toward Ripky, according to eRadarrua monitoring of northern front drone activity. (Source: @eRadarrua/103415)

A military commissar in the Volyn region pulled a truck driver from his cab while the vehicle was in motion, and the driver rammed several cars attempting to avoid being drafted. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32049)
Four military commissars in Ternopol pulled a man from a car in the middle of the road and carried him to their van, with a policeman opening the van door for them. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32058)
Strike UAVs were detected heading toward Chornomorsk, Lymanka, and Odesa from the Black Sea, indicating a maritime-based drone threat to southern Ukraine. (Source: @kpszsu/70913)
A reactive UAV was detected in Dnipropetrovsk region with a previous course from Samara, suggesting southern drone activity along the Dnipro corridor. (Source: @eRadarrua/103405)
A UAV was observed in Kirovohrad region passing near Kompaniyivka on a northern course, indicating ongoing drone movements in the central-southern sector. (Source: @kpszsu/70922)
A UAV was detected in Kirovohrad region moving past Adzhamka toward Kropyvnytskyi, showing continued aerial activity in the central front area. (Source: @eRadarrua/103438)

Fundraising efforts collected 300,000 hryvnias across two campaigns to produce five quality long-range drones with a 30 km range, designated for use on the Zaporizhzhia direction to destroy enemy forces. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69570)

GUR MOU received three long-range kamikaze aircraft from fundraising campaigns to destroy Russian logistics on the Zaporizhzhia direction, with two collection rounds conducted to fund the aircraft. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69569)
